definitions.gloss: precisely because; that's exactly why; it is because of that that …
definitions.explanation: An emphatic conjunction combining だから (so, therefore) with the focusing particle こそ. Used to single out the preceding reason as the very reason for what follows, often to push back against an unstated objection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。だからこそ⟦やりたい→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: It's hard. That's exactly why I want to do it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だからこそ、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's precisely because you're important to me that I want to tell you the truth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧、⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れ→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}できる→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧んだ。
examples.english: It's precisely because you have no experience that you can take on the challenge without fearing failure.

notes:
Combines だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (so; therefore) with ⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧, an emphatic particle that singles out one element as 'the' relevant one. The effect is to insist that the stated reason — not anything else — is what matters.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Sentence-initial: ◯◯。だからこそ△△。— preceding sentence states the reason.
- After a clause + から: ◯◯⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧△△ (with ⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧ attached directly to から).
- Often answers an implicit 'isn't that a problem?' with 'no — that's exactly why we should …'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- だからこそ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ: that's precisely why it matters
- だからこそ⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧: that's exactly why I want to say (it)
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧だからこそ: precisely now; now of all times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: so; therefore (neutral; no emphasis)
- ⟦そのため→そのため：08500_sonotame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: for that reason (more formal, written)
- ⟦それゆえ→それゆえ：17273_soreyue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: therefore (literary)
